description_en: Queries the SSL settings of a PolarDB cluster
name: DescribeDBClusterSSL

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98094.html operation to query the details of all clusters under your account, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:

Items.description_en: The list of SSL connection information

SSLAutoRotate.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic SSL certificate rotation is enabled. Valid values:

Enable: Enabled.

Disable: Disabled.

This parameter is supported only when the database engine is PostgreSQL-compatible or Oracle syntax-compatible
SSLAutoRotate.description_zh:
是否开启SSL证书自动轮转。取值：

Enable：开启

Disable：关闭

仅当数据库引擎为 PostgreSQL 兼容或 Oracle 语法兼容时，支持该参数

SSLEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) encryption is enabled. Valid values:

Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Shutdown
SSLEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启SSL加密。取值：

Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

SSLExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the SSL certificate. The time is in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format (UTC)
